pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against pyramiding into positions showing less than +$5.00 unrealized gain; zero scaling into micro-consolidations.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandate an ATR-based buffer of at least $1.50 away from psychological rounding levels and high-impact liquidity pools before entry execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger trailing sentinel harvest mode instantly once floating profit breaches +$10.00 to prevent degradation back to break-even.
